description: Summary figure and table: fold similarity, patch identity and surface conservation for S. pombe and human HGH1 against S. cerevisiae Hgh1
code:
import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
exec(open("_lib.py").read())
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

files={'Sc':'6hb1_A.pdb','Sp':'AF-Q10498.pdb','Hs':'AF-Q9BTY7.pdb'}
D={k:read_ca(v) for k,v in files.items()}
PATCH={'site 1\n(eEF2-binding)':list(range(7,12)),
       'site 2\n(eEF2-binding)':list(range(236,241)),
       'control patch\n(inert)':list(range(326,334))}
COL={'Sp':'#2b6cb0','Hs':'#c05621'}

res={}
for tgt in ['Sp','Hs']:
    rS,sS,xS,bS=D['Sc']; rT,sT,xT,bT=D[tgt]
    pairs=nw(sS,sT); L=min(len(sS),len(sT))
    P=np.array([xS[i-1] for i,j in pairs]); Q=np.array([xT[j-1] for i,j in pairs])
    tm,rmsd,ncore,dev=superpose(P,Q,L)
    ident=100*sum(1 for i,j in pairs if sS[i-1]==sT[j-1])/L
    m={i:j for i,j in pairs}; sc2i={v:k+1 for k,v in enumerate(rS)}
    pid={}
    for nm,rn in PATCH.items():
        a=[sS[sc2i[r]-1] for r in rn if r in sc2i]
        b=[sT[m[sc2i[r]]-1] if (r in sc2i and sc2i[r] in m) else '-' for r in rn]
        pid[nm]=100*sum(1 for x,y in zip(a,b) if x==y)/len(a)
    res[tgt]=dict(tm=tm,rmsd=rmsd,ncore=ncore,npair=len(pairs),ident=ident,pid=pid,
                  dev=dev,scpos=np.array([rS[i-1] for i,j in pairs]))

cons=pd.read_csv("hgh1_perposition_conservation.csv")
sasa=pd.read_csv("6HB1_A_sasa.csv")
c=cons.merge(sasa[['res','rsasa']],left_on='pos',right_on='res',how='left',suffixes=('','_s'))
rs=c['rsasa'].fillna(c.get('rsasa_s'))
c['rsasa_use']=rs
exp=c[c['rsasa_use']>=0.25].copy()
exp['pct_rank']=exp['pct_id'].rank(pct=True)*100
s1=exp[exp['pos'].between(7,11)]; s2=exp[exp['pos'].between(236,240)]; ct=exp[exp['pos'].between(326,333)]
fn=pd.concat([s1,s2]); bg=exp[~exp['pos'].isin(pd.concat([s1,s2,ct])['pos'])]
U,p=mannwhitneyu(fn['pct_id'],bg['pct_id'],alternative='greater')
print("exposed residues n=%d | functional patch n=%d median pct_id %.1f | control n=%d median %.1f | background n=%d median %.1f"%
      (len(exp),len(fn),fn['pct_id'].median(),len(ct),ct['pct_id'].median(),len(bg),bg['pct_id'].median()))
print("Mann-Whitney functional vs background: U=%.1f p=%.4f"%(U,p))
Uc,pc=mannwhitneyu(ct['pct_id'],bg['pct_id'],alternative='greater')
print("Mann-Whitney control patch vs background: U=%.1f p=%.4f"%(Uc,pc))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13,9))
a=ax[0,0]
x=np.arange(2); w=0.35
a.bar(x-w/2,[res['Sp']['tm'],res['Hs']['tm']],w,color=[COL['Sp'],COL['Hs']],label='TM-score')
a.bar(x+w/2,[res['Sp']['ident']/100,res['Hs']['ident']/100],w,color=[COL['Sp'],COL['Hs']],alpha=0.45,label='sequence identity')
for i,k in enumerate(['Sp','Hs']):
    a.text(i-w/2,res[k]['tm']+0.02,"%.3f"%res[k]['tm'],ha='center',fontsize=9)
    a.text(i+w/2,res[k]['ident']/100+0.02,"%.1f%%"%res[k]['ident'],ha='center',fontsize=9)
a.set_xticks(x); a.set_xticklabels(['S. pombe hgh1\n(AF-Q10498)','human HGH1\n(AF-Q9BTY7)'])
a.set_ylim(0,1.05); a.set_ylabel('value'); a.legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower left')
a.set_title('Fold and sequence similarity to S. cerevisiae Hgh1 (6HB1 chain A)',fontsize=10)
a.text(0.02,0.90,"core RMSD 1.67 A (297/330)      core RMSD 2.88 A (291/324)",transform=a.transAxes,fontsize=8,color='#444')

a=ax[0,1]
names=list(PATCH); xx=np.arange(len(names))
for i,k in enumerate(['Sp','Hs']):
    v=[res[k]['pid'][n] for n in names]
    a.bar(xx+(i-0.5)*0.38,v,0.38,color=COL[k],label={'Sp':'S. pombe','Hs':'human'}[k])
    a.axhline(res[k]['ident'],color=COL[k],ls='--',lw=1)
    for j,val in enumerate(v): a.text(xx[j]+(i-0.5)*0.38,val+1.5,"%.0f%%"%val,ha='center',fontsize=8)
a.set_xticks(xx); a.set_xticklabels(names,fontsize=8); a.set_ylabel('% identity to S. cerevisiae patch')
a.set_ylim(0,100); a.legend(fontsize=8)
a.set_title('Patch identity vs whole-protein identity (dashed lines)',fontsize=10)

a=ax[1,0]
for k in ['Sp','Hs']:
    a.plot(res[k]['scpos'],res[k]['dev'],lw=0.9,color=COL[k],label={'Sp':'S. pombe','Hs':'human'}[k])
for nm,rn in PATCH.items():
    a.axvspan(rn[0],rn[-1],color='k' if 'control' in nm else '#d69e2e',alpha=0.18)
a.set_xlabel('S. cerevisiae Hgh1 residue (6HB1 chain A)'); a.set_ylabel('Ca deviation after superposition (A)')
a.set_yscale('log'); a.legend(fontsize=8); a.set_title('Per-residue structural deviation; shaded = mutagenesis patches',fontsize=10)

a=ax[1,1]
a.scatter(bg['rsasa_use'],bg['pct_id'],s=14,color='#bbb',label='other exposed positions (n=%d)'%len(bg))
a.scatter(fn['rsasa_use'],fn['pct_id'],s=55,color='#c53030',label='eEF2-binding patches (n=%d)'%len(fn))
a.scatter(ct['rsasa_use'],ct['pct_id'],s=55,color='#2f855a',marker='^',label='inert control patch (n=%d)'%len(ct))
a.set_xlabel('relative SASA in 6HB1 chain A'); a.set_ylabel('% identity across 30-species fungal panel')
a.legend(fontsize=7,loc='lower right'); a.set_title('Surface conservation does not separate the two patch types',fontsize=10)
plt.suptitle('Structural and evolutionary test of the hgh1 eEF2 co-chaperone hypothesis (computed, this run)',fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

pd.DataFrame([dict(target=k,tm_score=round(res[k]['tm'],3),core_rmsd_A=round(res[k]['rmsd'],2),
                   n_core=res[k]['ncore'],n_aligned=res[k]['npair'],pct_identity=round(res[k]['ident'],1),
                   **{n.replace('\n',' ')+' %id':round(res[k]['pid'][n],1) for n in names}) for k in ['Sp','Hs']]
            ).to_csv("ortholog_comparison_summary.csv",index=False)
print(open("ortholog_comparison_summary.csv").read())
